Discounts $61.60 (2.0% of gross). Refunds $0. 4 void items. 17 takeout orders / $143.75, 5 dine-in / $62.00, 0 delivery. 83 card payments, 0 open orders, no auto-clockouts.
Versus Monday Aug 10 ($3,181.75): net -5.2%, gross -5.5%, orders -1.9%, guests +2.2%, avg order -3.4%. Labor improved slightly, 27.0% -> 26.1%.
Versus the 4-Monday average ($3,594.63 across Aug 10, Aug 3, Jul 27, Jul 20): net -16.1%, orders -5.9%, avg order -10.8%. Labor 26.1% vs a 26.2% blended average.
Read: Monday held up far better than Sunday did (-5.2% SDLW vs Sunday's -28.4%), but it is still well under the four-week Monday trend and the ticket is soft. These SDLW and 4-week figures were computed in-run from the four prior Monday emails because the single-location email for Aug 17 -- which carries Toast's own comparison block, plus dayparts, revenue centers, checks and void dollars -- had not landed by 7:13 AM. It usually arrives ~7:39 AM.

SLING -- Today's report arrived 7:00 AM PT: 6 employees, 6 shifts, 30.25 scheduled hours, 0 uncovered, 0 overtime, 0 off. Kitchen covered by Isael Salvador Narciso. Also on: Sarah Palmer (barista), Christine Vargas and Andrew Turner (bar), Augustine Arroyo and Bri Kelley (servers). That is +6.75 hours over Monday's 23.50 on a day that just posted -16.1% against its own 4-week average -- worth a look before the shift starts.

GOOGLE ADS -- Live scrape completed. Mon Aug 17: $62.38 / 823 impressions / 22 clicks / 2.67% CTR / $2.84 avg CPC / 0 conversions. Spend more than doubled while impressions dropped 331 and clicks dropped 6. Performance Max consumed $49.02 of $62.38 on 571 impressions and 8 clicks -- a $6.13 CPC, versus $0.95 on the BHC Coffee Search campaign, which delivered 14 of the 22 clicks at 5.56% CTR for $13.36. Search is doing the work; PMax is absorbing the budget. PMax now shows 'All asset groups limited by policy' with the budget limitation gone, so the policy disapproval is the remaining fixable constraint and has been standing for days. Two campaigns remain paused.

YELP ADS -- Scrape failed again; the dashboard redirected to the login page. Credentials were not entered. This is day 12. All Yelp figures on the board are from the Aug 7 read and should be treated as stale. Joal has been emailed.

TRIPADVISOR -- No ad performance report in the last 3 days. Nothing actionable.

unanswered.text: great food staff was on point very friendly, I highly recommend it and definitely driving 3 hours to go back.
unanswered.draftReply: Sergio, three hours each way is about the highest compliment a kitchen can get -- thank you. Glad the crew took care of you; they earned that one. Come see us next trip down, first round's on the house. -- The Brewhouse

unanswered.text: We were looking for a dog friendly restaurant on our way home to san diego. The food was great and our dog loved what you had. The waitress was great.
unanswered.draftReply: Betty, so glad you and your pup both found what you were after. The patio is one of our favorite things about this place and dogs are always welcome out there. Safe travels home to San Diego -- stop in again next time you're headed down the coast. -- The Brewhouse

unanswered.text: Beer was not good at all. Got botulism from taco. Recovering now. Avoid this place.
unanswered.draftReply: Donald, I'm sorry to hear you've been unwell. A report like this is something I take seriously and want to look into properly. Please reach out to me directly at the restaurant so I can get the date and details of your visit and review it with our kitchen. I hope you're feeling better. -- Joal, The Brewhouse

unanswered.text: Wow. Horchata Latte? Yes please. Excellent service, even better Baristas. A must stop when in SB
unanswered.draftReply: Geoff, the horchata latte gets that reaction a lot -- glad it landed. Our baristas will be very happy you called them out by name. See you next time you're in town. -- Brewhouse Coffee
